create_pe_audio_processor: create a PeAudioProcessor instance with feature extractor and tokenizer for PE audio model inference
load_pe_audio_processor: load a pretrained PeAudioProcessor from HuggingFace Hub for audio feature extraction and tokenization
process_pe_audio_input: process raw audio input through PeAudioProcessor to extract features and tokenize text labels
configure_pe_audio_feature_extractor: configure the PeAudioFeatureExtractor component of PeAudioProcessor for audio preprocessing
configure_pe_audio_tokenizer: configure the AutoTokenizer component of PeAudioProcessor for label tokenization
